title: PowerView Vs SoftTouch: Smart Shade Comparison
content:
Answer

PowerView Automation offers extensive smart home integration and scheduling capabilities, allowing control via smartphone, tablet, or voice commands, while SoftTouch motorization provides straightforward, wand-operated convenience. PowerView shades can be programmed to automatically adjust throughout the day, a feature SoftTouch shades do not offer, relying instead on direct manual operation. For homes in Florida, where intense sunlight and humidity affect window treatments, In the Shade recommends considering how each system's features align with long-term energy management and user interaction preferences.

Overview

This article explores two popular motorization options for window treatments: PowerView Automation and SoftTouch Motorization. It highlights the primary distinctions between these systems, including their control methods, installation requirements, and compatibility with smart home platforms. Homeowners can determine which system best fits their needs and lifestyle.

The article also includes a labeled real-world hypothetical, featuring Evelyn, to show how different preferences can lead to selecting one system over the other.

  • System Overview: Compare the general features of PowerView and SoftTouch motorization.
  • Key Differences: Review the distinctions in functionality.
  • Real-World Example: See when Evelyn chooses PowerView.
  • SoftTouch Shades: Discover the simplicity of SoftTouch.
  • System Selection: Determine which smart shade system is a better fit.
  • Home Integration: Learn how to make the smart choice for your home.

PowerView and SoftTouch Motorization

PowerView® Automation offers automatic blinds and shades that respond to smartphone, tablet, or voice commands. This advanced system allows for detailed scheduling and custom scene creation, which helps manage sunlight throughout the day. In the Shade installs these systems to give homeowners precise control over their window treatments.

SoftTouch motorization, in contrast, provides a direct, wand-operated system for shades. This battery-powered option focuses on simplicity, letting users adjust shades with a light touch. Both PowerView vs SoftTouch systems address different preferences for smart shade control, offering homeowners distinct operational experiences.

Feature PowerView Shades SoftTouch Shades
Control Options Smartphone app, Pebble remote, voice commands, advanced scheduling Wand-operated, light touch adjustment
Power Sources Rechargeable batteries, plug-in, hardwired options Battery-powered wand system (SoftTouch motorization)
Smart Home Integration Compatible with major platforms like Apple HomeKit and Google Home (PowerView Automation) Limited to no smart home integration
Scheduling Advanced scheduling and custom scene creation No automated scheduling

Key Differences Between PowerView and SoftTouch

Hunter Douglas offers two distinct motorized shading systems, PowerView and SoftTouch, each designed to meet varying homeowner preferences for control and automation. PowerView Automation provides extensive smart home connectivity with multiple control options, while SoftTouch Motorization offers direct, localized operation via a wand.

PowerView shades integrate with platforms like Apple HomeKit and Google Home, allowing homeowners to manage shades alongside other devices. In contrast, SoftTouch shades focus on straightforward, touch-activated functionality, appealing to those who prefer simplicity without complex automation. PowerView vs SoftTouch shades cater to different needs based on desired convenience, integration, and budget.

Feature PowerView Automation SoftTouch Motorization
Control Options App, remote, voice commands, scheduling, smart home integration with PowerView Automation Wand or light touch operation
Installation Complexity May require professional installation for advanced features and hub setup Designed for easier DIY or straightforward professional setup
Scheduling & Scenes Advanced scheduling and custom scene creation No automated scheduling; manual operation only
Smart Home Integration High compatibility with major smart home platforms Limited to no smart home integration
Power Source Options Rechargeable batteries, plug-in, hardwired Typically battery-powered wand system, requiring occasional battery replacement
Ideal User Tech-savvy homeowners seeking high control and customization Users prioritizing simplicity, ease of use, and quick adjustments with SoftTouch motorization

When to Choose PowerView

Choosing between automated smart shades and simpler motorized options involves balancing convenience, integration, and budget. Both offer distinct user experiences and technological capabilities.

Evelyn is debating which type of motorized shades to install in her home. She's drawn to the idea of a fully integrated smart home system with PowerView shades, but also appreciates the simplicity and ease of use offered by SoftTouch motorization, questioning if the added complexity of PowerView is truly necessary for her needs. Should Evelyn prioritize the advanced smart home integration and scheduling of PowerView shades, or the straightforward, wand-operated convenience of SoftTouch motorization?

Recommendation: PowerView Automation

In the Shade recommends PowerView Automation for homeowners seeking advanced smart home integration and daily scheduling capabilities. This system offers extensive control options and can be programmed for automated adjustments, which may be beneficial for managing sunlight and comfort.

SoftTouch Motorization: Simple Smart Shades

SoftTouch motorization provides direct, wand-operated convenience for window treatments, appealing to users who prefer straightforward functionality. This system offers an easy-to-use experience, ideal for quick adjustments without complex automation. Its design supports either simple DIY installation or straightforward professional setup, minimizing disruption in existing homes.

SoftTouch shades are powered by a battery wand system, which typically requires recharging every 6 to 12 months. This manual charging schedule contrasts with hardwired options found in more advanced systems. For residents here, the straightforward functionality of SoftTouch motorization offers a reliable solution for managing light and privacy without the need for extensive smart home integration.

FeatureBenefit
Wand OperationAllows for simple, direct manual control of shades.
Battery-PoweredUses a wand system, suitable for easy DIY or professional setup.
Ease of UseOffers quick adjustments without complex programming or apps.
Simplified InstallationSoftTouch shades can be installed like standard shades, requiring no electrical work.
Manual ControlThe system prioritizes straightforward interaction, fitting well in homes where complex automation is not desired.
Cordless DesignSoftTouch motorization offers a clean, cord-free aesthetic that enhances child and pet safety.

Which Smart Shade System is Right?

Selecting an automated shade system depends on individual needs, home characteristics, and desired functionality. Homeowners here benefit from considering both ease of installation and long-term energy management.

For homes with large glass areas or those prioritizing integration with existing smart home platforms like Apple HomeKit or Google Home, PowerView shades offer significant advantages. SoftTouch shades provide a simpler solution, ideal for those who prefer direct manual control without complex programming.

Florida's warm climate means energy efficiency is a priority. PowerView shades can reduce heat gain by automatically lowering during peak sun hours, which helps lower cooling costs. We advise clients to assess their comfort with technology and their home's specific sun exposure when making this choice.

Consideration PowerView Automation SoftTouch Motorization
Installation Often requires professional installation, especially for hardwired systems. SoftTouch shades can be installed like standard shades, ideal for existing homes with minimal disruption.
Smart Home Integration Designed for full smart home integration, compatible with major platforms. Limited integration; functions primarily as a standalone system.
Control Options App-based, remote, voice commands, and advanced scheduling. Simple wand operation for straightforward control.
Energy Management Programmable schedules automatically adjust shades to manage heat gain. Relies on manual adjustment for energy-saving benefits.
Power Source Rechargeable batteries, plug-in, or hardwired options. Typically uses a battery-powered wand system.
Aesthetics Sleek design with hidden motors, fitting luxury home styles. More standard design, wand operation may be visible.
User Experience Sophisticated control and customization for tech-savvy users. Easy to use, practical for those who prefer simplicity.

Making the Smart Choice for Your Home

Selecting the right smart shade system depends on individual preferences for control, automation, and aesthetic integration. Homeowners often weigh advanced features against ease of use and budget when making this decision.

Florida's intense UV radiation can degrade window treatments quickly, so programmed shades may offer better longevity by reducing manual wear and exposure during peak sunlight hours. PowerView Automation allows for advanced scheduling to protect furnishings and manage solar heat gain, while SoftTouch motorization requires direct interaction.

Product Best for Budget Reason
PowerView Automation Smart home integration and advanced scheduling Higher Offers app, remote, and voice control, with programmable scenes.
SoftTouch Motorization Simple, tactile control Moderate Provides easy wand operation for quick adjustments.
Custom window treatments Unique window shapes or specific design needs Varies Tailored to fit challenging windows and match interior styles.
Energy efficiency management Reducing cooling costs Varies Automated adjustments help maintain indoor temperatures, especially on west-facing windows.

In the Shade can assist with selecting and installing the ideal shade system, ensuring it meets specific home requirements and lifestyle preferences here.

FAQ

Navigating the world of automated window treatments can be a bit overwhelming, so we've compiled some common questions to help clarify the distinctions between PowerView and SoftTouch shades. This section addresses key differences in operation, smart home capabilities, and ideal use cases to help you make the best choice for your home.

QuestionAnswer
How does the wand operation of SoftTouch shades compare to the app and voice control of PowerView?SoftTouch shades use a wand for direct, manual adjustment, offering straightforward control. PowerView shades provide more advanced options, including smartphone app control, remote operation, and voice commands. This allows for greater convenience and integration with smart home systems.
What are the main differences in smart home integration between PowerView and SoftTouch systems?PowerView shades are designed for extensive smart home integration, compatible with platforms like Apple HomeKit and Google Home. SoftTouch motorization offers limited to no smart home integration, functioning primarily as a standalone system for direct shade control.
When should a homeowner in Florida choose PowerView shades over SoftTouch?A homeowner in Florida might choose PowerView shades if they desire advanced smart home connectivity, detailed scheduling for managing sunlight and heat, and voice control options. PowerView's automation can help manage the intense sunlight and reduce cooling costs.
What is the primary advantage of SoftTouch motorization for users who prefer simplicity?The primary advantage of SoftTouch motorization is its ease of use and straightforward, wand-operated control. This system is ideal for individuals who prefer simple, direct manual adjustments without the complexity of apps or programming.

What are the primary distinctions between Hunter Douglas PowerView and Somfy Softtouch for automated window treatments?
PowerView offers advanced smart home integration, app-based scheduling, and scene creation. Softtouch primarily provides simple, touch-activated control directly at the window for easy, cord-free operation. The main distinction lies in PowerView's comprehensive smart features versus Softtouch's focus on localized, manual ease of use.

How well do Hunter Douglas PowerView shades integrate with smart home systems for homes in Florida?
Hunter Douglas PowerView shades offer robust integration with major smart home platforms, allowing for centralized control and advanced automation within your Florida home. This system supports sophisticated scheduling and scene creation through its app.

Does Somfy Softtouch provide a suitable solution for basic, automated window treatments in a Florida home?
Yes, Softtouch offers a convenient and simple solution for basic automated window treatments in a Florida home. It provides easy, touch-activated control for raising and lowering shades without complex programming. This makes it ideal for straightforward automation needs.

How do the power source and installation requirements differ for PowerView and Softtouch smart shades in Florida?
PowerView shades typically offer various power options, including battery wands, plug-in power supplies, and hardwired solutions, providing flexibility for different installation needs. Softtouch shades, designed for simplicity, often utilize an integrated battery power source and feature a streamlined, cord-free installation.
